svg.title: U-Net
svg.desc: Convolutional neural network with 11 layers: Image (128×128×1), Conv 1 (conv 3×3, 128×128×64), Pool 1 (max 2×2, 64×64×64), Conv 2 (conv 3×3, 64×64×128), Pool 2 (max 2×2, 32×32×128), Bottleneck (conv 3×3, 32×32×256), Upsample 1 (up 2×2, 64×64×256), Conv 4 (conv 3×3, 64×64×256), Upsample 2 (up 2×2, 128×128×256), Conv 5 (conv 3×3, 128×128×128), Mask (conv 1×1, 128×128×2).
